paragraphs: The E-Pace D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium family. It's been fitted to the E-Pace across the entire X540 production run from 2017 onwards. The AJ200D shares the same basic architecture as the petrol AJ200, but features diesel-specific components including high-pressure fuel injection, a DPF system and EGR. Like other Ingenium diesels in the JLR range, the AJ200D has a documented timing chain wear pattern at higher mileages — which is why we replace the timing chain components and injector seals as standard on every rebuild. Jaguar E-Pace D200 Engine Codes AJ200D (X540, 2017–present) A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the E-Pace D200 from 2017 onwards across the entire X540 generation. Known for timing chain and injector seal wear over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guide rails, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the E-Pace D200 from 2023 to present. The AJ200D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
